[1/3] Paged KV stage-2b plan: persistent row-pointer table, remove per-token table resolution, A/B 8x32 + 2048, fidelity/ids, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Stage 2's per-row table arithmetic cost 6-15%; a row-pointer table built once at load should remove the 32-head multiplier.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recover paged decode/prefill to within the 2% budget or close IDEA-1517 as a speed idea.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: exact ids/fidelity; dependency: pointer table 14.7 MB/sequence + block tables; concurrency: read-only after load; state: f32-only paged path.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Full suite, 5/2048/continuous id parity, fidelity tiers, 12 continuous pairs + 3x2048 pairs, full revert.

[1/3] Continuous slots 4->8 capacity study: f16/f32 KV, 8x32 load, A/B + memory, report

impact_assessment.why: The paged/memory line is closed for speed; continuous batching still has headroom from admitting more requests per weight pass, and the engine already exposes --sequences.
impact_assessment.benefits: Measure the aggregate gain and the memory cliff before recommending a higher slot count.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical transcripts; dependency: none, config-only; concurrency: 8 slots in one forward_batch; state: KV memory doubles/quadruples.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Interleaved 4/8 pairs, f16 and f32 arms, load-time tracking, report-only commit.

[1/3] Budget-aware --sequences auto: plan/place slot resolution, 4-preference/8-cap, A/B + fidelity, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 11 showed 8 f16 slots can add ~34% aggregate but can lose under memory pressure; a fixed default is unsafe.
impact_assessment.benefits: Opt-in auto picks 8 when the model/KV plan fits and falls back otherwise, capturing the throughput win with a budget guard.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical transcripts; dependency: existing plan/budget APIs; concurrency: slots chosen before load; state: CLI-only, opt-in.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 3 paired auto-vs-4 runs, fidelity tiers, budget readout, full revert.

[1/3] Live-headroom sequences auto: free physical minus reserve, full-context KV headroom, pressure fallback, A/B + fidelity, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 12 used total usable and place().max_sessions, which can shrink context and overcommit; the policy needs live free memory and full-context KV accounting.
impact_assessment.benefits: Safer auto slot count under pressure; exposes the place() context-shrink trap.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical transcripts; dependency: plan/budget APIs; concurrency: slots fixed before load; state: CLI-only opt-in.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normal + simulated-pressure runs, 3 paired A/B, fidelity tiers, full revert.
